scope: Unchanged T146-U R0-A/full38/full-U100, GEO, 3 g/cm2; not E/r4 or T141/T150

same_Y_candidate.name: raw TC3 window increments, only if exposed and validated by the same IREM configuration
same_Y_candidate.definition: One channel, no sum of overlapping counters, no rescaled unfolded particle flux. This identifies a candidate for audit, not an implemented operating mode.

decision: Stop this addressed public-data check with two independent gaps. Keep T146 as a conditional requirements theorem. No numerical a or instrument-specific gain is assigned.
first_reopening_input: A specific IREM firmware/ICD revision demonstrating raw or rigorously bounded corrected TC3 acquisition with 1s windows, 0.5s stride, timestamps/live time/loss status and <=1s complete post-window path. This changes the timing rejection only; the joint angular/species/memory/loss data remain required.
